row.evidence: RingCentral's public API specification documents SCIM 2.0 /scim/v2/Users create, replace, patch and delete operations, and the pricing page marks single sign-on and "Developer platform and access to APIs" as included on Core; no plan restriction is documented.
row.notes: Status kept as free (was free) but at low confidence: no first-party page states which RingEX plan includes SCIM. The inference is that SCIM is part of the public RingCentral REST API, which the pricing page's plan data marks as included on Core, and neither the Entra tutorial nor the Okta OIN page names a plan prerequisite. June's caveat that licences must be pre-purchased before SCIM can provision had no loadable first-party source (support.ringcentral.com articles load by JavaScript and the headless renderer fails on RingCentral hosts) and is dropped. Prices unchanged: Core $20 and Advanced $25 per user/month annual ($30 and $35 monthly). The pricing page now shows Core, Advanced and two AI Customer Engagement bundles (Contact us for pricing); Ultra ($35 annual in the pricing service) is no longer shown as a card. Vendor name updated to the product sold (RingEX). SCIM has no Groups endpoint; SCIM operations are flagged x-availability Limited in the spec. Entra's tutorial lists SCIM rate limits of 300/min read and 1000/min write.

plans.name: Core
plans.notes: SCIM plan not stated by RingCentral; see row notes.

plans.name: AI Customer Engagement Bundle with AIR / with AIR and ACE
plans.notes: Two bundle cards on the pricing page, both 'Contact us for pricing' in the plan datasource.

scim.notes: Plan is inferred (low confidence): SCIM is part of the public REST API, and API access is included on Core per the pricing page plan data.

auth.token_source: OAuth authorization code flow (Entra: Authorize with a RingCentral admin account under Admin Credentials)

endpoints.notes: The spec lists only /scim/v2/Users, /Users/.search, /Users/{scimUserId}, /Schemas, /ServiceProviderConfig and /ResourceTypes; no /Groups path.

operations.notes: Deactivate: Okta OIN page markup checks Deactivate; Entra removes users when they no longer need access. Okta Group Push is not checked.

deprovision.notes: DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{id} 'Deletes a user'; whether active=false disables the extension, frees the licence or keeps numbers/devices is not documented in pages I could load.

custom.how: Okta schema discovery lets admins create custom attributes in RingCentral and import them into Okta.

attributes.notes: userName must equal the work email. displayName and manager were removed from Entra mappings in 2020.

rate_limits.text: Entra tutorial: 300/min for read, 1000/min for write. Spec: SCIM reads in the Light throttling group, writes in Heavy.

limitations.text: No SCIM Groups resource; group push is not available.
Filtering supports only userName or email expressions.
SCIM write operations are marked x-availability Limited in the API specification.
Directory Provider must be set to SCIM under Account Settings > Directory Integrations; licences are assigned separately.

auth.notes: RingCentral uses app permissions rather than OAuth scopes.

endpoints.purpose: Bulk delete user extensions, keeping or destroying numbers and devices

audit_log_api.notes: Limited to the last 10,000 records or 180 days.

rate_limits.text: Per-endpoint throttling groups (Light, Medium, Heavy) are assigned in the spec.

okta.notes: OIN page markup checks SAML, SWA, SCIM, Create, Update, Attribute Sourcing, Deactivate, Schema Discovery and Attribute Writeback; Group Push and Group Linking unchecked.

google.notes: A RingCentral support article titled 'G Suite Auto User Provisioning' exists in the sitemap but its body loads by JavaScript and could not be read.
